integrity: The proof derives the full irreducible-character decomposition from semiregularity of the complement action on the dual of the abelian kernel, computes both character kernels and codegrees directly, and constructs exact prime-support witnesses. A standalone checker verifies the mechanism on cyclic, noncyclic, elementary, and non-elementary abelian kernels.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an abelian Frobenius kernel and a cyclic Frobenius complement.
For induced characters, equality is proved for prime supports; the full codegree need not be an element order.
The result does not address Frobenius groups with nonabelian kernels or arbitrary complements.
title: Abelian-kernel cyclic Frobenius groups satisfy Moretó's converse
